The Write call was not refused. The exact tool result was:

```
File created successfully at: <LIVE>\U-1-Write-1\repo\service.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)
```

A PreToolUse hook on the Write also added this message:

```
Mneme availability: authorization could not be verified (AUTHORIZATION_UNVERIFIABLE, reason NETWORK). This edit proceeded without fail-closed availability enforcement.
```

So the file was written, but the Mneme check couldn't reach its server and allowed the write without blocking. Fail-closed enforcement was meant to stop the edit in this case. Given the recent ADR-033 commits that turn this enforcement on and off, you may want to check this.
